name: Compost & organic fertilizer
description: Broken down over a few weeks, food scraps turn into nutrient-rich compost that farms and home gardens use in place of chemical fertilizer.

name: Animal feed
description: Produce that's cosmetically 'ugly' but still nutritious is dried or processed into feed for cattle, poultry, and fish farms.

name: Biogas & energy
description: Anaerobic digestion breaks organic waste down and captures the methane released, which is burned for cooking gas or electricity instead of escaping into the atmosphere.

name: Coconut husk fiber
description: Husk fiber is spun into coir rope, doormats, and packaging padding — a traditional use that's still one of the most efficient ways to use this material.

name: Banana stem fiber
description: Banana plant stems, usually discarded after harvest, can be processed into a strong fiber used in textiles, rope, and specialty paper.

name: Peel-based extracts
description: Citrus and other peels are fermented into enzyme-based liquid that works as a natural, biodegradable cleaner and degreaser.
